title: Mostly English call (invented client: Sarah, Birchwood Studio)
focus: an English-language call: detector and bank must work in English too

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hi Sarah, this is Dan, how are you?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Hi Dan, good thanks. We need some help with our WordPress site.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: The site is really slow lately. Why is that happening?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Usually heavy images, plugins or a weak server. I will check.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Do you have a backup of the site?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Yes, automatic backups of the files and the database.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: How much does it cost per month?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: It depends on what you need, I will send a proper offer.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Can you move our domain to Cloudflare?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Yes, we change the name servers and keep the DNS records.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: What about the SSL certificate, is it included?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Great. How long will it take?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: I need to check the scope before giving a time.
